_comment: Homophones test the STT engine's language model, NOT the dictionary. A dictionary entry cannot fix these: both spellings are valid English words, so a blanket replacement would break the other sense. See docs/benchmarks.md.

passed.spoken: write the right value to the root route
passed.note: all four correct -- write/right and root/route

passed.spoken: The principal engineer explained the principle
That will affect the effect on latency
Two nodes are too few to serve the site we cite

failed.spoken: Clear the cache before you count the cash
failed.actual: Clear the cash before you count the cash
failed.note: cache -> cash. The technical sense lost to the common word.

failed.spoken: The queue took its cue from the sink that failed to sync
failed.actual: The Q took its cue from the sink that failed to sink
failed.note: queue -> Q and sync -> sink. Two failures in one sentence, both technical senses.

unexpected_normalisation.note: The engine expanded the contraction unprompted, changing the speaker's words.
